query: ("DoorDash commission" OR "Uber Eats fees" OR "keep what we sell" OR "quit DoorDash") (restaurant OR restaurantowner) -is:retweet lang:en

hits.snippet: Your DoorDash commission is not your DoorDash cost. One restaurant statement: $9,411.15 sales / $787.55 commission / $976.74 other fees → $7,646.86 left. Commission rate 8.37%; effective cost 18.75%. The dashboard celebrates sales. The restaurant lives on what is left.
hits.never86_angle: Teach labels: headline commission ≠ take-home — pitch Never86 buy-now as keep-what-you-sell vs statement math

hits.snippet: What changed after the DoorDash fee audit. They didn't quit DoorDash entirely — they changed how they use it to KEEP more. Nearby restaurants: pickup through DoorDash (no delivery fee / reduced service fee). Two of three weekly orders shifted off full-rent delivery.
hits.never86_angle: Dual-run pattern (Outbites-class): shrink marketplace spend — Never86 owns social buy-now for repeats

notes: Prefer statement-math / effective-cost language for sales-lead teach. Bright Data still 401 — X+Composio Active.
